proof_body:
by
  intro R _ X S hS n
  refine ⟨fun x => ⟨fun h => CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₂ X hS x h, ?_⟩, fun x => ⟨fun h => CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₃ X hS x rfl h, ?_⟩, fun x => ⟨fun h => CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.covariant_sequence_exact₁ X hS x h rfl, ?_⟩⟩
  · rintro ⟨x₁, rfl⟩
    rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_comp_mk₀, S.zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀_zero, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
  · rintro ⟨x₂, rfl⟩
    rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_second_deg_zero, hS.comp_extClass, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
  · rintro ⟨x₃, rfl⟩
    rw [CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_assoc_of_third_deg_zero, hS.extClass_comp, CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.comp_zero]
target_source: ∀ (R : Type) [Ring R] (X : ModuleCat.{0} R) (S : CategoryTheory.ShortComplex (ModuleCat.{0} R)) (hS : S.ShortExact) (n : ℕ), (∀ x₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X S.X₂ n, x₂.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero n) = 0 ↔ ∃ x₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X S.X₁ n, x₁.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f) (add_zero n) = x₂) ∧ (∀ x₃ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X S.X₃ n, x₃.comp hS.extClass rfl = 0 ↔ ∃ x₂ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X S.X₂ n, x₂.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.g) (add_zero n) = x₃) ∧ (∀ x₁ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X S.X₁ (n + 1), x₁.comp (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext.mk₀ S.f) (add_zero (n + 1)) = 0 ↔ ∃ x₃ : CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext X S.X₃ n, x₃.comp hS.extClass rfl = x₁)
